title: Meow button
description: Small-cornered (4px) fintech buttons at medium weight: an orange fill that dims on hover, an orange fill that turns ink on hover, a hairline outline that fills white, a blue fill, a quiet ghost and a text link with an arrow that fades. Optional leading icon and trailing arrow.
notes: transitions are 100–200 ms on the standard ease (cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1)), as in the original
name: meow-button

props.name: href
props.description: renders a link when set, a button otherwise

props.name: variant
props.description:
primary: orange fill that dims a little on hover · invert: orange fill that turns ink on
hover · outline: hairline box that fills with the card colour · accent: the blue fill ·
ghost: no box until hovered · link: bare text with an arrow, fades on hover

props.name: size
props.description: sm: 40px tall (header) · md: 42px tall (sections) · lg: 48px tall (inside the email form)

props.name: icon
props.description: a small icon before the label

props.name: arrow
props.description: a small arrow after the label

props.name: type
props.description: the button's type when it isn't a link (e.g. "submit" inside a form)
